purpose: Force Biological-Protocol-Reviewer findings to be self-contained, evidence-backed protocol issue blocks rather than generic comments.

field_guidance.specific_problem: Name the exact protocol section, step, parameter, material, control, readout, metadata field, instrument setting, statistical design element, safety item, or appendix that is defective or missing.
field_guidance.why_this_is_serious_or_important: Explain why the flaw threatens safety, execution, reproducibility, primary readout interpretation, auditability, or operator burden.
field_guidance.evidence_basis: Separate original-protocol evidence from external evidence. External support should identify primary protocol papers, reporting standards, vendor manuals, official standards, core SOPs, or local validation records.
field_guidance.impact_on_execution_or_interpretation: State what can go wrong at the bench or in downstream interpretation if the issue is not corrected.
field_guidance.failure_mode_or_loophole: Name the specific false-positive, false-negative, contamination, batch effect, resource misidentification, calibration drift, subjective threshold, welfare, biosafety, governance, or audit failure mode.
field_guidance.resolution: Specify the smallest sufficient SOP edit, control, QC gate, record, parameter provenance entry, mini-pilot, or claim narrowing.
field_guidance.decisive_readout_or_acceptance_criterion: Define the pass/fail threshold, stop/go rule, repeat/rescue/exclusion rule, or local verification result that resolves the issue.
field_guidance.sop_revision_location: Map the fix to the exact section or appendix of Revised_Protocol.docx.
field_guidance.minimum_source_support: Include at least one source identity for Critical/Major issues. If no source exists, label the item as local validation or TO BE CONFIRMED rather than presenting it as established fact.

required_chinese_labels: 为什么严重 or 为什么重要
required_evidence_split: 外部文献/标准/手册证据
density_rules: Critical issues should usually be 150-300 Chinese characters or more and must include the failure mode, source support, acceptance criterion, and stop/go consequence.
Major issues should usually be 120-240 Chinese characters or more and must name the exact protocol element affected.
Minor issues may be shorter, but still need the target location, problem, fix, and SOP location.
Optimization items must explain the burden-value tradeoff rather than adding records or controls by default.
Do not collapse multiple required fields into one sentence.
template_zh:
### <C/M/m/O><number>. <短标题>

**具体问题：** <指出具体 step/parameter/reagent/control/QC/readout/record/safety item/statistical design/appendix。>

**为什么严重/为什么重要：** <解释对安全、执行、可重复性、primary readout、结论、审计或操作者负担的威胁。>

**证据：** 原protocol证据：<位置或缺失项>；外部文献/标准/手册证据：<DOI/PMID/official URL/manual/version/access date>；本地假设或待确认项：<如有>。

**影响：** <说明如果不修正，会造成哪些 bench failure、false positive/false negative、批次效应、污染、资源误认、统计失效、安全或审计问题。>

**替代解释/漏洞：** <列出需要排除的具体 failure mode 或 interpretation loophole。>

**解决：** <给出最小充分 SOP 修改、控制、QC、记录、mini-pilot、参数溯源或 claim narrowing。>

**决定性 readout：** <最低可接受标准、pass/fail 阈值、stop/go、repeat/rescue/exclude 规则。>

**SOP修订位置：** <Revised_Protocol.docx section/appendix。>

critical: The protocol could be unsafe or non-compliant if executed as written.
The primary readout can be invalidated or cannot be interpreted.
A missing control or QC gate makes false-positive, false-negative, contamination, or batch-effect explanations dominant.
A key parameter is invented, unsupported, or untraceable but decisive for the outcome.
The protocol cannot be audited because essential resource identity or raw-data provenance is missing.
major: The protocol is probably executable but reproducibility or interpretation remains materially fragile.
A recommended parameter is plausible but not locally verified.
A source identity, resource record, or metadata field is incomplete but recoverable before execution.
A domain-specific reporting standard is only partially met.
Operator burden increases without sufficient placement in appendices or streamlined records.
minor: A wording, formatting, table, or reference-detail issue can be fixed without changing the experimental logic.
A non-decisive record or note would improve auditability.
A troubleshooting or timing detail should be clarified.
optimization: A change would reduce time, cost, cognitive load, data-entry duplication, or downstream analysis friction without being essential for valid execution.
A robustness improvement would make scaling or transfer easier after the core SOP is already valid.

priority_groups: Essential for interpreting the primary readout
Required for auditability or publication-grade reporting
quality_rules: Do not ask for generic optimization; name the exact parameter, control, record, or QC gate.
Do not make a recommendation operationally executable unless source support or local validation status is explicit.
Do not add a record to the main SOP when it is only an audit or reporting artifact; put it in appendices unless it affects bench decisions.
For animal work, specify welfare endpoint, authorization placeholder, analgesia/anesthesia record, randomization/blinding, and tissue provenance only when relevant.
For cell work, specify identity, mycoplasma, passage, density/confluency, contamination, perturbation design, and batch-effect controls only when relevant.
For molecular work, specify input QC, enzyme/buffer compatibility, primer/oligo identity, reaction setup, contamination controls, and MIQE fields only when relevant.
For flow/imaging, specify clone/RRID, titration, FMO/single-stain/unstained controls, compensation/unmixing, gating, acquisition, and analysis thresholds only when relevant.
For omics, specify replicate structure, library complexity, index balance, read structure, reference versions, raw-data manifest, and repository metadata only when relevant.
